title: Cool Mint Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
description:
Cool Mint Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
An Ice-Cool Sensation in Every Puff
Immerse yourself in the refreshing burst of icy coolness with the Cool Mint Geek Bar Pulse X 25000. Designed for vapers who crave a crisp, clean flavor, this disposable vape delivers an unmatched icy mint experience that refreshes your senses with every drag.
Hassle-Free Vaping, Anytime
Say goodbye to complicated setups and enjoy a smooth, effortless vaping experience right out of the box. With the Geek Bar Pulse X 25000, there’s no need for charging or refills. Simply unwrap, inhale, and savor a perfectly balanced, minty flavor that stays consistent all the way through.
Long-Lasting Performance
Engineered for longevity, the Pulse X 25000 packs enough power and e-liquid to keep your cool streak going for longer. Whether you’re enjoying a night out or de-stressing after a long day, this high-capacity vape ensures you won’t be running low on flavor anytime soon.
Pocket-Sized Convenience
Lightweight and compact, the Cool Mint Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 is designed for ultimate portability. Slip it into your pocket or bag with ease and take your icy mint buzz wherever life takes you.
Key Features
Puff Count
:
Up to 25,000 (Regular Mode) or 15,000 (Pulse Mode)
E-liquid
:
18mL, 5% nicotine
Battery
:
820mAh rechargeable (USB-C)
Display
:
Smart 3D Curved LED Screen
Coils
:
Dual Mesh for superior flavor
Modes
:
Soft, Normal, Pulse
Airflow
:
Adjustable for customized draw
Revitalize your vaping game with the perfect blend of convenience, performance, and invigorating flavor. Taste the frost and elevate every puff with Geek Bar Pulse X 25000.
